# Quality Indicators

This area groups the clinical quality indicators used to monitor and evaluate healthcare standards within the Danish registry system. It currently contains a dedicated section for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which catalogs the specific metrics tracked by DANIBD to assess diagnostic workups, postoperative care, biological treatment monitoring, and surgical outcomes across the entire patient journey.

## Pages

- [[topics/quality-indicators/ibd/index|Ibd]] — Catalogs the specific clinical metrics used by DANIBD to monitor IBD care, spanning diagnostics, surgery, biological therapies, and comorbidity surveillance.
